parameters.name: PolicyType
parameters.description: The type of the policy. Valid values: `System` and `Custom`.

parameters.name: UserName
parameters.description: The name of the RAM user.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ram attach-policy-to-user --policy-type Custom --policy-name OSS-Administrator --user-name zhangq0000 --resource-group-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
